Kingfisher Raises Guidance on Market-Share Gains
Kingfisher raised its outlook for the fiscal year, citing market share gains and rising sales in the first half.
The home-improvement retailer raised its guidance for fiscal 2027, saying it expects adjusted pretax profit of 595 million pounds to 635 million pounds ($795.3 million-$848.8 million).
It previously expected the metric to be in the range of 565 million pounds to 625 million pounds.

The company's sales for the half year rose to 6.86 billion pounds, up 0.8% on a reported basis from the same period a year earlier. Analysts had expected half-year sales for the group to be 6.88 billion pounds.
Kingfisher said its results got a boost from profits from market-share gains and momentum across trade and e-commerce.
Sales in its Screwfix tools business rose 6.1% to 1.07 billion pounds for the first half ended July 31.
Kingfisher also increased its free cash flow outlook to a range of 480 million pounds to 520 million pounds. It previously saw free cash flow between 450 million and 510 million pounds.
"Consistent delivery, strategic progress and opportunities ahead give us the confidence to upgrade our guidance," Chief Executive Officer Thierry Garnier said.
